name: DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description: Runs OpenClaw agent turns through an embedded DeepSeek Harness agent with its own tools, sessions, compaction, and goals.

dshHome.description: DSH home directory ($DSH_HOME) for settings.yaml, credentials, and session persistence. Defaults to ~/.dsh, sharing the machine's existing DeepSeek Harness configuration.

modelProvider.description: Optional DSH provider route override for embedded agents. Defaults to the DeepSeek Harness selection (settings.yaml or deepseek-official).

model.description: Optional DSH model id override, used together with modelProvider. Defaults to the DeepSeek Harness selection.

workspaceRoot.description: Filesystem root the embedded DSH sandbox treats as workspace-write. Defaults to the home directory.

persona.description: System-prompt persona line for the embedded DSH agent. Defaults to the built-in OpenClaw embedding persona.

turnTimeoutMs.description: Safety cap (ms) for one embedded DSH turn. Defaults to 900000.
